title: Colloquium in Art History; The Shape of Power: Stories of Race and American Sculpture
description: This seminar, organized in conjunction with an exhibition of the same name at the Smithsonian American Art Museum (SAAM), will examine the history of sculpture in the United States from the 19th century to the present and explore how this medium has shaped, challenged, and reimagined concepts of race and identity. Most class meetings will take place at SAAM, and students must be able to travel to the museum in downtown D.C. for class.
